 Oral Order
4 08-10-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest for the offences alleged under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, registered in connection with Buxar (T) P.S.Case No. 531 of 2024.
3. The informant is a 70 years old person presently residing in Jaipur.
His permanent address is Churamanpur- District Buxar.

According to allegation, the accused persons including the petitioner,
under a conspiracy, after obtaining the Aadhaar card and PAN card of the informant, created a forged sale deed impersonating him.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13741 of 2025(4) dt.08-10-2025 4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has no role either in the Shiv Kumar Paswan @ Shiv Kumar Ram @ Shiv ... vs The State Of Bihar on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12733656/
1 alleged transaction or in creating forged sale deed.

entities.text: Shiv Kumar Paswan @ Shiv Kumar Ram @ Shiv ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He is an innocent person and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

5. On the contrary, the learned counsel for the informant has submitted that the stamp paper on which the forged sale deed was documented, was received by the petitioner which shows his involvement in the alleged conspiracy.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also keeping in view the allegation against the petitioner, this Court is not inclined to grant him the privilege of anticipatory bail, which is hereby rejected.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) HR/-
